Queuewe
Avigail Bahat | Senior product designer | Take-home task

Queuewe

An app for 1:1 sessions. Book a slot, then follow your turn live.

Main features:

  1. Choose a slot: visitors pick an available time.
  2. Live turn time: visitors always see when their turn is.
  3. Delay notifications: when a session runs late, everyone waiting gets the new time.
  4. Session control: the manager starts each session, then ends or extends it.
Overview

Queuewe: A booking app for 1:1 meetings

A simple booking system where people book a 1:1 meeting, see their place in line, get notified when it's their turn, and see delays. Parent-teacher meetings are the first use case.

Today these meetings run on a shared Google Sheet. It's a list, so nobody knows how long the wait is, and no one is updated on changes.

Manager (Teacher or staff)

  • Sets the cutoff for when visitors can edit or cancel
  • Creates the schedule
  • Sends an invite link to visitors
  • Checks visitors in and out to keep the line moving
  • Gets notified when a session is about to end, and can extend it. Visitors are notified of the change.

Visitor (parent)

  • Books a slot from the invite link
  • Edits or cancels a session until the manager's cutoff
  • Gets notified of delays
  • Gets notified when a session is coming up, starting, and about to end

Visitor journey wireframes
1 of 3

From invite link to setting the meeting

The visitor signs in and sets a time slot, and can edit it until the session starts.

Visitor journey wireframes
2 of 3

The session is coming up

As the session is coming up, the session time becomes bigger and clearer. The visitor gets notified of a delay and when they need to come in.

Visitor journey wireframes
3 of 3

Session start to end

During the session, the visitor can see it in progress and gets told when time is almost up. At the end, they can send feedback. Once the session moves to past sessions, the home screen shows an empty state with the option to start their own queue or learn how it works.

Solution

UI screens

The home screen and a lock screen tracker widget.

Home screen (visitor)See your session time and how many people are ahead of you. If the manager delays the queue, the new time shows here.
Tracker widgetA live tracker on the lock screen counts down to your turn, so you do not need to open the app.
Summary

Summary

  • The problem: parent-teacher meetings run on a shared Google Sheet, with no live position and no notifications.
  • Users: parents (primary), teachers and school staff (secondary).
  • Scope: parent booking and the live queue, with the teacher side at wireframe level.
  • Journey: book a slot, track the queue, get notified when it's your turn.
  • Next: finish the wireframes and the polished UI screens.

Appendix

Research: competitors and users

The brief was open, so I spent a day researching competitors, user types, queue types, and possible actions.

Competitors

  • QueueBee, queue management for customer waiting lines
  • QRQ, queue management and virtual queue software
  • Queue App, virtual waiting list (Google Play)
  • Clalit, queue and waiting-list setup on an outside service
  • Calendly, meeting scheduling

Users

  • Parent-Teacher talk
  • Salon
  • Gov service
  • Medical clinic
  • Buy tickets to something
  • Consultation
  • Hairdresser
  • Restaurant
  • Experience (art exhibit)
Appendix

Research: queue types and actions

Queue types

Live queuePeople join as they come, and wait their turn on the spot.
Booked queuePeople reserve a slot before they arrive, then join the queue on the day.
Physical meetingPeople meet in person at a set place, like a school or a clinic.
Virtual meetingPeople meet online by video call, using a link in their booking.

Main actions

  • Visitor: book and edit a slot, see the session time, view their slot, get delay and reminder notifications, cancel, check in when they arrive
  • Manager: set up the queue (slot time, multiple days), delay it, mark the session in progress and end or extend it, see who is now, see who is booked and checked in, skip a no-show, remove all queue, get told when a session is almost up
